tldr: ChemCrow is an LLM-powered chemistry agent that integrates 18 expert-designed tools to autonomously plan and execute chemical tasks including organic synthesis, drug discovery, and materials design.
contributions: Development of ChemCrow, an LLM chemistry agent integrating 18 expert-designed tools
Autonomous planning and execution of syntheses of an insect repellent (DEET) and three organocatalysts via RoboRXN platform
Guided discovery of a novel chromophore through human-AI collaboration
Demonstration that GPT-4 as evaluator cannot distinguish clearly wrong completions from ChemCrow's performance
methods: The authors integrated 18 expert-designed chemistry tools (covering reactions, molecules, safety, search, and standard functions) with GPT-4 using a ReAct/MRKL framework. The LLM follows a Thought-Action-Action Input-Observation iterative chain-of-thought process, querying tools and incorporating their outputs until reaching final answers. Tools include LitSearch/WebSearch, Name2SMILES, ReactionPlanner, and ReactionExecute. Syntheses were executed on IBM Research's RoboRXN cloud-connected robotic platform, with an ActionCleaner function enabling autonomous adaptation of invalid procedures.
results: ChemCrow autonomously synthesized DEET and three known thiourea organocatalysts (Schreiner's, Ricci's, and Takemoto's) successfully. It guided discovery of a novel chromophore with predicted absorption closest to 369nm target (measured at 336nm, RMSE of 37nm for the Random Forest model). Expert chemists preferred ChemCrow over GPT-4 across all three evaluation metrics (correctness of chemistry, quality of reasoning, degree of task completion), especially on complex tasks. GPT-4 only outperformed ChemCrow on easier tasks where answers could be memorized from training data. EvaluatorGPT (GPT-4 as evaluator) concluded GPT-4 was better on average, revealing its inability to assess factuality.
limitations: Current results limited by the amount and quality of the 18 chosen tools
Evaluation tasks are limited in scope and variety
Tool outputs depend on underlying tool quality, which may contain inaccuracies
LLM may struggle to analyze observations due to limited chemistry concept understanding
Synthesis procedures from predicted plans are not always directly executable and require adaptation
GPT-4 as evaluator fails to provide trustworthy assessments when factuality is key
